job.organization: Los Angeles County Office of Education

items.item_text: 01. PLEASE READ THE FOLLOWING STATEMENT: Answer the following questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. You are not expected to answer at the highest level of each of these items to be qualified. The application will be evaluated for minimum qualifications. Your responses to the supplemental questions below may also be used to determine your qualifications beyond the minimum qualification requirements for this classification in a training and experience (T&E) evaluation. Referring to your application/resume, listing "see resume", or incomplete responses will NOT qualify as a response to any question. Questions that are answered in this method will be considered INCOMPLETE and may result in DISQUALIFICATION. You are required to answer ALL of the supplemental questions as truthfully and accurately as possible. Your responses to these questions are subject to verification and may be assessed in subsequent examination parts. All experience, education, training, and certification must be included in your application in order to be considered. Any sign of deliberate misinformation or intentional exaggeration will result in disqualification from this examination process and possible bar from future employment opportunities with the Los Angeles County Office of Education (LACOE). Select "Yes" if you have read, understood, and agree to the above statements. Select "No" if you have read, understood, and DO NOT agree with the above statements and voluntarily withdraw your application for this position. Options: Yes | No

02. What is your highest level of education? Please Note: Proof of education will be required by the close of application filing on December 8, 2026. You must attach a copy of your diploma and/or transcript for review. Degrees must be earned from an institution of higher learning recognized by the Council for Higher Education. Foreign degrees and credit units require translation and equivalency established by an agency recognized by the Commission on Teacher Credentialing. Options: No High School Diploma or GED equivalent | High School Diploma or GED equivalent | Some college coursework but no degree | Associate's Degree | Bachelor's Degree | Master's Degree | Doctorate Degree

03. If you possess a bachelor's and/or a higher degree, please specify the major of study (as listed on your diploma or transcript). If you do not possess a bachelor's degree, please type "N/A". Note: Degrees must be from an institution of higher learning accredited by a regional accrediting organization recognized by the Council of Higher Education Accreditation. Additionally, foreign degrees and credit units require translation and equivalency established by an agency recognized by the Commission on Teacher Credentialing

04. This classification requires eligible candidates to have completed at least 24 semester or 36 quarter verifiable college coursework units in business administration, public administration, accounting, finance, or other fields closely related to the job requirements of this classification . Do you meet this requirement? Options: Yes | No

05. Please list the courses you have completed in business administration, public administration, accounting, finance, or other fields closely related to the job . Please format your response in the following format: a) Official course title b) Number of units (specify semester or quarter) c) College or university where you completed the course If you have not taken any courses in the above fields listed, list "N/A". Note: Failure to provide the required information may result in disqualification of your application due to incompleteness.

06. In order to be considered for this position, you will need to provide an unofficial/official transcript to verify that you meet the education requirements for this position (i.e., Bachelor's Degree conferred and required coursework). It is strongly recommended that you attach your transcript(s) to your application prior to submission. If you cannot provide a transcript at the time of submitting your application, please note that you will need to provide an unofficial/official transcript via email, postal mail, or in person by December 8, 2026 . Please note that foreign transcripts require credit unit translation and equivalency established by an agency recognized by the Commission on Teacher Credentialing. Please select "Yes" to confirm that you have read, understand and agree to this statement. Options: Yes | No

07. How many years of experience do you have in business or financial analysis involving budgeting, financial forecasting and financial trend analysis? Options: No experience | Less than 1 year | 1 year but less than 2 years | 2 years but less than 3 years | 3 years but less than 4 years | 4 years but less than 5 years | 5 or more years

08. Please describe your experience in business or financial analysis involving budgeting . For each related experience, please include: a) Your job title(s) b) Name of the organization(s) c) Job duties/responsibilities related to the job areas described above d) Length(s) of employment If no experience in this area, list "n/a".

09. Please describe your experience in business or financial analysis involving financial forecasting . For each related experience, please include: a) Your job title(s) b) Name of the organization(s) c) Job duties/responsibilities related to the job areas described above d) Length(s) of employment If no experience in this area, list "n/a".

10. Please describe your experience in business or financial analysis involving financial trend analysis . For each related experience, please include: a) Your job title(s) b) Name of the organization(s) c) Job duties/responsibilities related to the job areas described above d) Length(s) of employment If no experience in this area, list "n/a".
